law_name: Law on Copyright and Neighboring Rights of 10 June 1999
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Art. 18(1); joint works from death of last surviving author; collective and anonymous works 70 years from publication)
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (protected for author's life + 70 years per Commons summary) (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne in force 2 Jun 2004. No evidence found of WCT/WPPT accession (not confirmed either way). Law 23/2011 created a collective management society (in force 18 Jan 2012). Term from Commons summary.
